They wouldn’t know which god had blessed him or even who he was because of his secret identity, and that was something he could control when he told them.
Rex asked, "How many Apostles of Life are there compared to other types?"
[APOSTLES OF LIFE: APPROXIMATELY 40-50 ACTIVE]
[APOSTLES OF OTHER MAJOR GODS: 30-40 EACH]
[APOSTLES OF FORBIDDEN GODS (INCLUDING YOURSELF): ESTIMATED 20-30 TOTAL, MOSTLY OPERATING IN SECRET]
[NOTE: GODDESS OF LIFE MOST ACTIVE IN APOSTLE CREATION DUE TO HER EMPHASIS ON HEROISM AND SAVING MORTALS]
[NOTE: FORBIDDEN GOD APOSTLES RARELY ADVERTISE THEIR PATRON TO AVOID PERSECUTION]
And that was exactly what Lustia had told him.
The Goddess of Life was very pushy about giving champions power, which meant that Rex would have many targets to find and kill.
But the Forbidden God Apostles kept their ties secret, so Rex could be the Lustful Villain without anyone knowing right away that he was working for Lustia.
"Last question." Rex said, "The Apostle gathering is in three days.
What’s the plan?
How does it work?"
[APOSTLE GATHERINGS: TYPICALLY FORMAL COORDINATION MEETINGS]
[STRUCTURE: HOSTED BY LOCAL AUTHORITY (IN THIS CASE, VALENTINA VON STARLIGHT)]
[PURPOSE: SHARE INTELLIGENCE, COORDINATE STRATEGIES, ASSIGN ROLES FOR UPCOMING OPERATIONS]
[ATTENDANCE: VOLUNTARY BUT STRONGLY ENCOURAGED FOR REGIONAL APOSTLES]
[EXPECTED OUTCOME: FORMATION OF STRIKE TEAMS TO TARGET DEMON STRONGHOLDS]
[YOUR ROLE: ATTEND AS NEWLY RECOGNIZED REINCARNATOR, OBSERVE AND GATHER INTELLIGENCE ON OTHER APOSTLES]
[OPPORTUNITY: IDENTIFY PRIORITY TARGETS FOR FUTURE ELIMINATION, ESTABLISH CONTACTS AND ALLIANCES]
In the dark, Rex smiled.
He needs exactly three days to get ready.
He needs three days to adjust to the Academy, familiarize himself with the students, and strategize how to manage the gathering.
Three days from now, he would find himself in the same room as Apollo Brightsoul and possibly a dozen other Apostles of Life.
The mark on his hand pulsed once, barely noticeable, as if it was responding to his excitement.
"This shit is going to be very interesting..."

chapters.title: Chapter 94. Lustia’s Gift Shop: Open at 12AM Whether You Like It or Not
paragraphs: "Fuck... it’s all of those thoughts that made me want to go to sleep without raising my desire energy for today."
"Well... I think it’s reasonable to adapt first, and I don’t want to continue fucking Mara here because it could go wrong if someone heard us."
"I need to find a room that at least has soundproofing... maybe I could ask Marceline tomorrow with a chance to seduce her, of course."

Rex closed his eyes and went to sleep earlier than he had planned, which was unusual for him. He usually stayed up late working through what-ifs and making plans for different courses of action, but tonight his mind was full of information.
The Academy, the Apostle gathering, Apollo Brightsoul, Valentina, the Nightwing family, Marceline, and many other things all mixed together in a mental soup that wouldn’t settle down.

He finally gave up and decided that it would be better to plan things out in the morning. He needed to give his brain a break, and making him work when he was this worn out would only make things worse.
He got into bed, pulled the blankets over himself, and closed his eyes.
He fell asleep quickly, but it wasn’t the peaceful dark he had hoped for.

Instead, he felt the now-familiar pull on his soul, that disorienting lurch that meant he was being called to a place between worlds. This time the change was easier and less jarring than his first trip to Lustia’s domain, but it was still very unpleasant in a way that made his stomach turn.
"Ah shit... not this shit again. Don’t tell me that bitch is already feeling all horny to be calling me again," Rex sighed.
And then...

He was back in the throne room when he became fully aware of what was going on. He became fully aware of the obsidian buildings, the red light filling the air, and the pervasive feeling of desire, akin to the humidity of a jungle.

Lustia was sitting on her throne, with her cheek resting on her palm and one leg crossed over the other in a graceful way. She looked completely at ease, even bored, but her violet eyes followed him with obvious interest.
"Well, well, well... it’s my lovely apostle," she said, her voice always having a hint of seduction. "Do you miss me already?"
"I bet you wanted one good fuck session again, huh?"
"You fucking called me here, by the way." Rex said while crossing his arms.
Rex felt a sudden and sharp wave of anger wash over him. "You could have told me more before putting me in this situation for the second time."
"Half-explanations and vague hints don’t help when I’m trying to get around a capital city full of divine champions who would kill me if they knew what I was."
"I’m trying to rest and getting ready to plan shit for tomorrow, so state all your business other than sex because I’m not in a mood right now."
Lustia smiled wider, showing off her teeth that were just a little too sharp. "Oh my, someone is acting grumpy right now, and it’s a rare thing that libido didn’t awaken at all?"
"Did I wake you up from your beauty sleep?"
Rex stated, "I’m serious," and despite his irritation, he maintained a composed tone.
"If you’re going to make me your apostle, I need to know everything... Surprises are fine when they help me, but going into situations where the wrong word could get me in trouble is not okay."
"Mmm." Lustia moved her legs apart and leaned forward, changing her posture from relaxed to alert. "You’re right... I’m sorry, really..."
Rex blinked. He didn’t really think she would say she was sorry.
"Do you want to punish me for that? We could play BDSM," Lustia laughed teasingly.
"Fucking hell..." Rex facepalmed. "I said I’m not in a mood for today; save it for later.
"Hehehe, alright, okay..."
"I’ve been a goddess for a long time," Lustia said. "Most people are so focused on getting what they want right away that explaining long-term strategy seems boring, but you’re not like that."
"You think ahead, plan for the worst, and you know that power without knowledge is just wasted potential."
She got up from her throne and walked toward him with slow, graceful steps. When she reached him, one hand was on his chest, where his heart would be if he were real.
"So let me be clear," she said. "Everything is going exactly according to the destiny of lust that I can see."
"Every plan you devise will succeed because it aligns with fundamental truths about desire and human nature, which are too powerful to merge with."

"When you manipulate someone, it succeeds because you’re not fighting against their nature, you’re amplifying it... and of course, when you seduce, it works because you’re offering them what they secretly crave even if they won’t admit it."
Rex thought about that carefully. "You mean that my success isn’t just luck...? It’s going to happen because I work with desire instead of against it."
"Exactly." Lustia’s smile was real now, and she was happy. "Other apostles try to make the world fit the shapes their gods like."
"The Goddess of Life wants people to be selfless and pure, so her champions spend all their energy fighting against natural human impulses."
"That kind of disgrace are tiring and pointless. You, on the other hand, accept people as they are and use them."

"That’s why you don’t need to worry so much about planning every possible branch. Just trust your gut like you usually do in your previous life." Lustia held his chin. "Have faith that your passion will unlock every opportunity for you."
"The world wants you to succeed because you accept the truth instead of denying it."
Rex’s shoulders felt a little less tense. And he thinks that made sense, and even better, it fit with what he had been through so far.
Every situation he’d been in had turned out well, not because he’d forced things to go his way, but because he’d understood people and given them reasons to do what he wanted.
"Okay," he said. "I can work with that way of thinking."

"Good boy." Lustia moved her hand from his chest to his jaw and tilted his head so she could look him in the eyes. "Before you wake up, I have gifts for you. And of course, that’s the reason why I bring you here."
"I’ll give you three new skills that will make it much easier for you to get into Mordecai’s group so that you can at least play with two sides like you’re controlling everyone like a chess piece."
"What...? That’s actually helpful." Rex then looked interested. "Now this is what I want... I’ve been saving my energy for that infinite regeneration."
She waved her hand, and the space between them sparkled. A see-through interface appeared, hovering in the air like a screen made of red light and shadow.
It showed information in a way that made Rex think of video game menus from his past life, but with a lot more style.
[LUSTIA’S GIFT: ABILITY SELECTION]
[CHOOSE THREE ABILITIES FROM AVAILABLE OPTIONS]
[CURRENT ENERGY AVAILABLE: 2000 POINTS (SUFFICIENT FOR MULTIPLE SELECTIONS)]

The list moved in front of him, showing dozens of options, from tools for improving combat to tools for subtle manipulation. Rex quickly looked through them, already sorting them into groups based on how useful and strategic they were.
Enhanced Strength. Enhanced Speed. Enhanced Durability. Too straightforward, and he already had decent physical capabilities, thanks to his full-potential telekinesis.
Mind Reading. The allure of Mind Reading was undeniable, yet it could potentially overwhelm him with the cacophony of thousands of thoughts.
Illusion Creation. While useful, it was limited in comparison to the options he was about to select.
His eyes quickly focused on three options that would make his current strategy more effective.
"Alright... it seems like I know some abilities that could help me move more freely with my planning." Rex smirks.
"Shapeshifting," Rex said, pointing to the first choice. "I need to be able to change how I look whenever I want, not just hide behind a mask."
"If I can become different people, I can get into any place and even cover up all my crime."
[SHAPESHIFTING SELECTED]
[ABILITY: ALTER PHYSICAL FORM INCLUDING HEIGHT, BUILD, FACIAL FEATURES, VOICE]
[LIMITATION: CANNOT PERFECTLY MIMIC SPECIFIC INDIVIDUALS WITHOUT EXTENSIVE OBSERVATION]
[DURATION: UNLIMITED WHILE CONSCIOUS]
"Teleportation," Rex said, picking the second one. "Mobility is survival."
"It’s nearly impossible to trap or corner me if I can move around as I please."
[TELEPORTATION SELECTED]
[ABILITY: INSTANT SPATIAL RELOCATION TO ANY LOCATION WITHIN VISUAL RANGE OR PREVIOUSLY MEMORIZED]
[LIMITATION: REQUIRES BRIEF CONCENTRATION (2-3 SECONDS), CANNOT TELEPORT INTO SOLID OBJECTS]
[COOLDOWN: NONE, BUT RAPID SUCCESSIVE USES MAY CAUSE DISORIENTATION]
"And Full Potential Energy Manipulation," Rex said, picking the third one. "I need to be able to directly control magical energy."
"I don’t just want to use spells that are already made; I want to be able to shape raw power into whatever I need."
[ENERGY MANIPULATION SELECTED]
[ABILITY: DIRECT CONTROL AND SHAPING OF AMBIENT MAGICAL ENERGY]
[APPLICATIONS: CUSTOM SPELL CREATION, ENERGY ABSORPTION, DEFENSIVE BARRIERS, OFFENSIVE BLASTS]
[LIMITATION: REQUIRES UNDERSTANDING OF ENERGY FLOW AND STRUCTURE, COMPLEX APPLICATIONS DEMAND CONCENTRATION]
"Oh my... you really are smart, aren’t you?" Lustia said while biting her lips. "I bet that with all those three new abilities..."
"You can do whatever your desire wants..."

chapters.title: Chapter 95. Lustia Said ’Opportunity.’ She Meant ’Demon Army at 3AM.
paragraphs: The interface blinked and then disappeared, and the three powers flowed into Rex like liquid light. He felt the three powers integrate with his existing abilities, settling alongside his foresight, telekinesis, and the Lustful Villain transformation.
"Now... that’s some good SHIT!" Rex powered up by releasing many shockwaves around his body, where Lustia could feel them.
For a moment, it was too much for him. His mind suddenly realized things he had never been able to do before.

He could feel the power to change his body like clay, to move through space like walking through an open door, and to grab the magic threads that ran through reality and shape them into whatever he wanted.
"Fuck yeah," Rex said. "Now this is... what I really wanted for my future plans."

"The shapeshifting is going to be a game changer because I can just cause chaos with every reincarnator body to make them the villain." Rex clenched both his fists. "But of course... I really need to examine them to their fullest to create a perfect replica."
"That’s better." Lustia laughed because she was pleased with how he reacted. "Now you’re ready for what’s coming."
"Huh...?" Rex asked again. "What’s coming?"
"Opportunity," Lustia said. "C’mere... you need to pay for all that..."
She pulled him down to kiss him, and it was not like the usual way. This was a goodbye, a send-off, and a blessing wrapped in desire.
When she pulled back, her smile was proud and predatory. "Do it now, my apostle."
"This is the moment you’ve been waiting for."
"Don’t ever think about it too much... just go and follow your true DESIRE."
And the world dissolved.
Rex’s eyes flew open to a mess.
He first noticed the noise. The noise was not the calm of a sleeping inn, but the loud sound of emergency sirens cutting through the night.
He could hear far-off shouts, the sound of armor and weapons clanging together, and the organized chaos of quick movement.
The second thing he saw was light. Red light, harsh and unnatural, came in through his window from outside.
"What the fuck is that...? Had the demon already ambushed this place?" He was already up and moving before he realized it.
In three steps, he crossed the room and looked out the window at the city.
And what he just said was true that the demons were attacking Aethelgard while everyone was asleep; consider it an ambush attack from their sly minds.

Rex could see parts of the outer wall lit up by explosions and magical fire from his third-floor window. The defensive wards that usually gave off a soft glow of protection were now glowing brightly and pushing back against whatever was hitting them from the outside.
"Pathetic... they’re not ready enough, but still... it’s those reincarnators’ job who want to be heroes to step in now.
There was an army outside the walls, and he could see it even from this distance.
Demons. A lot of them.
There were more things there than Rex had ever seen or thought of. They filled the fields outside the city like a living tide.
Some were small and imp-like, while others were huge brutes that stood twenty feet tall. Demons with leathery wings flew around in circles above, catching the light of the fire.
Rex’s Foresight turned on by itself, showing him dozens of possible futures that could happen from this point on. In most of them, the city’s defenses worked.
There were hundreds of strong knights inside who would respond to this threat. The walls were strong, and the guards were well-trained.
But he saw chances in a few branches. Chaos was a ladder, and this kind of big attack would make it easier for him to take advantage of gaps in attention.
"So this is the opportunity Lustia talked about," Rex said to himself. "This is it..."
"My mind starts working again now because I had a clear visual of it."
He stepped away from the window and took a moment to think. The attack had just begun, so it would take hours to find a solution.
He had time to watch, pick out targets, and make his move when the time was right.
His mind was buzzing with new skills, ready to unleash their power. If he could change shape, he could maneuver through the chaos undetected.
He could get anywhere he needed to be right away with teleportation, and energy manipulation would give him more ways to attack and defend than just telekinesis.
And most importantly, his Lustful Villain form would let him do things without having to connect them to Rex Rexilion.

He quickly put on dark, practical clothes that would blend in with the shadows and went to the door. There was a lot going on at the inn, with guests and staff members rushing around in different states of panic or getting ready.
Using his foresight, Rex slipped past them, circumnavigating the building until he was outside.
The streets of Aethelgard were transforming into a battlefield. City guards were establishing defensive lines at key intersections.
People were being escorted to designated shelters. Meanwhile, mages were preparing to launch attacks from a distance by positioning themselves on rooftops.
He could see bigger groups getting ready to move from the Academy, which was probably the organized response from Valentina and the more powerful residents.
Rex found a quiet alley and climbed to the rooftops, because of his improved physical abilities, the climb was easy. From this higher ground, he could see the battle much more clearly.
The walls on the outside were holding, but just barely. The defenses were being breached by the sheer number of attacks, even though most of the demons were being killed or pushed back.
Several parts were clearly damaged, with cracks and scars from impacts on the stone. And then many defenders showed up.
Rex saw the Starlight family come onto the field. Helena’s magic was easy to spot right away: huge spells that wiped out whole groups of demons with elemental rage.
Fire, ice, lightning, and earth are all used with the skill of years of practice. Diana was on the walls, and her arrows hit demon eyes and throats with machine-like accuracy.
Elliot was at the front gates, and his sword work was clean and brutal as he cut through any demons that got past the first line of defense.
"Lily’s not here...?" Rex noticed that.
And there was also the Nightwing family, which was also easy to see.

Aurelia commanded a formidable presence on the battlefield. Her bare hands and feet hit with enough force to break bones and crush demon skulls. Iris moved like a shadow, honing her assassination skills to fight in the open as she went after demon commanders and broke up their formations.
Even Morwanna and Elaris could be seen, with the older women using magic that came from years of knowledge and power.
And the reincarnators were spread out among the defenders.
Rex’s system pinged all the time as it found dozens of people using powers given to them by different systems and blessings. He saw someone use gravity to crush demons into the ground.
Another made walls of force that demons broke against, and then another one moved at a speed that was almost as fast as Evelyn’s, leaving behind piles of dead demons.
"There’s that asshole..." Rex smirks when he sees Apollo Brightsoul is in the middle of one of the biggest groups of demons.
Rex was right. The golden-haired hero was just as gross in battle as he had thought.

He fought with the kind of selfless bravery that makes for outstanding stories. He put himself between demons and civilians, took hits meant for weaker defenders, and inspired others with shouts of encouragement and real concern for their safety.
His nine harem members fought with him in perfect harmony, each one making up for his weaknesses and making his strengths even stronger.
Behind him, the warrior woman with red hair acted as a formidable barrier.
With a shower of fire, the mage annihilated enemy formations.
The healer used bursts of healing magic every so often to keep everyone in fighting shape.
The elven archer gave precise support fire.
The others filled different tactical roles with the kind of practiced efficiency that showed they had all fought together a lot before.
Rex watched them fight for a few minutes and then he remembered how they fought. He paid attention to how Apollo moved, reacted, and acted.
All of this information will be valuable when he eventually addresses that issue.
But Apollo wasn’t the goal for him tonight.
Rex was looking for something else.

The noise was not the calm of a sleeping inn, but the loud sound of emergency sirens cutting through the night.
He could hear far-off shouts, the sound of armor and weapons clanging together, and the organized chaos of quick movement.
The second thing he saw was light.
Red light, harsh and unnatural, came in through his window from outside.
"What the fuck is that...?
Had the demon already ambushed this place?" He was already up and moving before he realized it.
In three steps, he crossed the room and looked out the window at the city.
And what he just said was true that the demons were attacking Aethelgard while everyone was asleep; consider it an ambush attack from their sly minds.
Rex could see parts of the outer wall lit up by explosions and magical fire from his third-floor window.
The defensive wards that usually gave off a soft glow of protection were now glowing brightly and pushing back against whatever was hitting them from the outside.
"Pathetic... they’re not ready enough, but still... it’s those reincarnators’ job who want to be heroes to step in now.
There was an army outside the walls, and he could see it even from this distance.
Demons.
A lot of them.
There were more things there than Rex had ever seen or thought of.
They filled the fields outside the city like a living tide.
Some were small and imp-like, while others were huge brutes that stood twenty feet tall.
Demons with leathery wings flew around in circles above, catching the light of the fire.
Rex’s Foresight turned on by itself, showing him dozens of possible futures that could happen from this point on.
In most of them, the city’s defenses worked.
There were hundreds of strong knights inside who would respond to this threat.
The walls were strong, and the guards were well-trained.
But he saw chances in a few branches.
Chaos was a ladder, and this kind of big attack would make it easier for him to take advantage of gaps in attention.
"So this is the opportunity Lustia talked about," Rex said to himself.
"This is it..."
"My mind starts working again now because I had a clear visual of it."
He stepped away from the window and took a moment to think.
The attack had just begun, so it would take hours to find a solution.
He had time to watch, pick out targets, and make his move when the time was right.
His mind was buzzing with new skills, ready to unleash their power.
If he could change shape, he could maneuver through the chaos undetected.
He could get anywhere he needed to be right away with teleportation, and energy manipulation would give him more ways to attack and defend than just telekinesis.
And most importantly, his Lustful Villain form would let him do things without having to connect them to Rex Rexilion.
He quickly put on dark, practical clothes that would blend in with the shadows and went to the door.
There was a lot going on at the inn, with guests and staff members rushing around in different states of panic or getting ready.
Using his foresight, Rex slipped past them, circumnavigating the building until he was outside.
The streets of Aethelgard were transforming into a battlefield.
City guards were establishing defensive lines at key intersections.
People were being escorted to designated shelters.
Meanwhile, mages were preparing to launch attacks from a distance by positioning themselves on rooftops.
He could see bigger groups getting ready to move from the Academy, which was probably the organized response from Valentina and the more powerful residents.
Rex found a quiet alley and climbed to the rooftops, because of his improved physical abilities, the climb was easy.
From this higher ground, he could see the battle much more clearly.
The walls on the outside were holding, but just barely.
The defenses were being breached by the sheer number of attacks, even though most of the demons were being killed or pushed back.
Several parts were clearly damaged, with cracks and scars from impacts on the stone.
And then many defenders showed up.
Rex saw the Starlight family come onto the field.
Helena’s magic was easy to spot right away: huge spells that wiped out whole groups of demons with elemental rage.
Fire, ice, lightning, and earth are all used with the skill of years of practice.
Diana was on the walls, and her arrows hit demon eyes and throats with machine-like accuracy.
Elliot was at the front gates, and his sword work was clean and brutal as he cut through any demons that got past the first line of defense.
"Lily’s not here...?" Rex noticed that.
And there was also the Nightwing family, which was also easy to see.
Aurelia commanded a formidable presence on the battlefield.
Her bare hands and feet hit with enough force to break bones and crush demon skulls.
Iris moved like a shadow, honing her assassination skills to fight in the open as she went after demon commanders and broke up their formations.
Even Morwanna and Elaris could be seen, with the older women using magic that came from years of knowledge and power.
And the reincarnators were spread out among the defenders.
Rex’s system pinged all the time as it found dozens of people using powers given to them by different systems and blessings.
He saw someone use gravity to crush demons into the ground.
Another made walls of force that demons broke against, and then another one moved at a speed that was almost as fast as Evelyn’s, leaving behind piles of dead demons.
"There’s that asshole..." Rex smirks when he sees Apollo Brightsoul is in the middle of one of the biggest groups of demons.
Rex was right.
The golden-haired hero was just as gross in battle as he had thought.
He fought with the kind of selfless bravery that makes for outstanding stories.
He put himself between demons and civilians, took hits meant for weaker defenders, and inspired others with shouts of encouragement and real concern for their safety.
His nine harem members fought with him in perfect harmony, each one making up for his weaknesses and making his strengths even stronger.
Behind him, the warrior woman with red hair acted as a formidable barrier.
With a shower of fire, the mage annihilated enemy formations.
The healer used bursts of healing magic every so often to keep everyone in fighting shape.
The elven archer gave precise support fire.
The others filled different tactical roles with the kind of practiced efficiency that showed they had all fought together a lot before.
Rex watched them fight for a few minutes and then he remembered how they fought.
He paid attention to how Apollo moved, reacted, and acted.
All of this information will be valuable when he eventually addresses that issue.
But Apollo wasn’t the goal for him tonight.
Rex was looking for something else.

chapters.title: Chapter 96. The Apostle of Justice Said ’I Sounded So Cool and Sigma’ Then Died.
paragraphs: His foresight grew longer, and it became more focused as it sifted through different options that he could use for this situation.

He was looking for a certain kind of demon that would help him reach his real goal towards the core point. He didn’t look for a mindless grunt or a combat expert, but someone who is smart, has connections, and is useful to reach Mordecai’s group.
The fight went on for hours. The sky went from full night to the first light of dawn, but the demons kept coming.
However, the situation began to shift. The defenders were holding their ground, and even more importantly, they were starting to push back.
The walls stayed the same, and there were surprisingly few casualties given how big the attack was. And the demon armies were clearly getting smaller as more and more of them were killed.
Finally, Rex’s foresight showed him what he had been looking for.
"There it is... something that I can use for this perfect plan."
He saw a vision very clearly in his mind. A female demon wore what looked like a maid’s uniform.
The elegant attire was a striking contrast to the harshness of the battlefield. She was running away from the main fight, moving through the shadows by the eastern wall.
And following her was a reincarnator, someone Rex’s system recognized as a low-level apostle of justice, one of the minor god’s champions who had come for the gathering.
In the vision, the reincarnator caught the maid demon and killed her by stabbing her in the back while shouting, ’In the name of justice.’
However, that vision was not final, allowing Rex to completely alter it.
He smiled in the dark and then clenched the fist that has the mark of lust until it responded to his desire.
"It’s time to put this baby on good work."

The transformation of the Lustful Villain proceeded smoothly, much like breathing. The mask appeared over his face, beautiful and scary, covering all of his features except for his eyes, which were visible through glowing red slits.
His clothes changed, becoming something darker and more flowing, like a living shadow taking shape. And most importantly, he changed in every way.
The aura of power that had been carefully hidden in his Rex Rexilion identity now shone brightly, making him seem dangerous and different.

His traits got better right away, thanks to the desire that had built up from his relationships with Lily and Mara and the partial connections he had made with Helena, Diana, Evelyn, Iris, and Elaris.
He could tell that his strength, speed, and durability were all better than they usually were.
"Holy shit... it far exceeds my expectations." Rex looked at his arms and legs. "I’m going to enjoy every bit of this..."
"And if this double life is addicting, then I’ll just have to stick with the Lustful Villain until I’m satisfied." Rex closed both his eyes to focus on his teleportation.
Rex used his new teleportation power to focus on the place that his foresight had shown him. He focused on the area next to the eastern wall, where the maid demon was likely hiding in the shadows.
He could see the spell structure taking shape in his mind, simple and beautiful, and then he stepped.
Reality bent around him when the teleportation activated.

He was on a roof near the Silver Rest one minute. The next thing he knew, he was standing in a small space between two buildings near the eastern wall, with shadows pooling around him like they were alive.
And there was the demon maid, just like his foresight had shown him.
She was beautiful in the way that many demons are, with features that were almost human but just a little bit off in ways that made people feel uneasy.
Her hair was silver-white and styled in a complicated way that somehow stayed perfect even though everything was going wrong.
Her skin was pale with a hint of blue underneath. Her eyes were bright red and wide open with fear right now.
And her outfit was a real maid’s uniform, black and white with many frills, and it looked great even though she was running away from a battle.
[DEMON DETECTED: LILITH NOCTURNE]
[CLASSIFICATION: SUCCUBUS VARIANT - MAID CLASS]
[AFFILIATION: MORDECAI VRAEL’S HOUSEHOLD]
[ROLE: PERSONAL ATTENDANT AND INTELLIGENCE GATHERER]
[DESIRE LEVEL: 0/100]
[THREAT LEVEL: LOW (COMBAT), HIGH (INFILTRATION)]
[STATUS: ELIGIBLE TARGET]
"Succubus...?!" Rex was shocked and also interested right away. "Fucking great..."

Just what he had been looking for. Someone who could get to Mordecai directly and act as his way into the demon lord’s group and, of course... for other things that led to more of his energy regeneration.
And right behind her, exactly on schedule, was the reincarnator who’d been hunting her.

The man was young, maybe twenty-five, and had a serious face that made it seem like he really believed in what was right and wrong. He wore light armor with symbols of his god on it, and he held a short sword that glowed with holy energy.
"Stop running, you cowardly demon!" he yelled, raising his sword. "Even if you are a woman! Your corruption stops here!"
"I serve justice for its purpose and uphold gender equality at the same time..." The reincarnator said that and then laughed. "Hahaha~! Damn, I sounded so cool and sigma!"
Lilith fell, and her back hit the wall of the building behind her. It was intriguing that her fear was solely due to the imminent threat of a human’s death.
Most of the demons Rex had met so far had been either aggressive or fearless. It was clear that this one was made for sneaking around, not fighting.
The reincarnator lunged, his sword aimed for Lilith’s heart.
"This is the end...!"
But then Rex intervenes.

His telekinesis reached out and caught the blade in the middle of a strike, stopping it in mid-air just inches from Lilith’s chest. The sudden resistance made the reincarnator trip, and he looked confused as he tried to figure out why his attack had failed.
"W-What the...!? H-How!? This sword is a gift from the god of justice itself!" He said with a panicked look.
Then he looked up and saw Rex standing there in his Lustful Villain form. The confusion turned into pure fear right away.
"W-what?" the person who had been reincarnated said. "Who... who the FUCK are you?!"
"Why are you protecting a demon? Don’t tell me you got seduced by the succubus’ powers!" He gritted his teeth. "You fucking weak! Why did you give in to your desire like that!?"
Rex didn’t bother to respond, just because talking to someone who was about to die was pointless.
His telekinesis flexed, and an unseen force wrapped around the reincarnator’s body from all sides at once. "W-What the...!? S-Stop this instant...!"
The man opened his mouth to scream, but Rex tightened his grip, stifling any sound before it could escape.
The result was brutal and complete. Bones shattered, organs ruptured, and blood vessels burst.

In just three seconds, the reincarnator’s body was crushed from the inside out. When Rex released his hold, what fell to the ground was not a corpse but a puddle of blood and liquefied tissue, barely contained by torn clothing.
"Apostle of Justice..." Rex landed in the puddle of blood. "What a fucking joke."
There was nothing left that could help find him. There was no face, no recognizable features, just a jumbled mess that could have come from any number of people who died in battle.
Rex saw Lilith, who was looking at him with a changed expression. Her red eyes were wide open, but not because she was scared, but because she was fascinated.
In admiration. There was a sense of reverence in the atmosphere.
[LILITH NOCTURNE: 0/100 → 70/100]
[REASON: DRAMATIC RESCUE FROM CERTAIN DEATH, DISPLAY OF OVERWHELMING POWER, PROTECTION OF THE VULNERABLE]
[SYSTEM NOTE: DEMONS CAPABLE OF DESIRE BONDS, ESPECIALLY SUCCUBUS VARIANTS]
[SYSTEM NOTE: RAPID INCREASE DUE TO INHERENT NATURE OF DEMON ATTRACTION TO DISPLAYS OF DOMINANCE AND ALSO WITH THE HELP OF YOUR LUSTFUL VILLAIN’S AURA]
Rex’s thoughts got stuck for a moment. "Now I can see why this form is powerful... it’s easy to get a whopping seventy points just from one encounter?"
"From nothing to seventy in a single move... that was astonishing, even considering what I had previously accomplished with Marcus through the psychological dominance bonus."
Then he thought about what Lustia had said. Demons worked on rules that were different from those of people.
They weren’t limited by the same moral codes or emotional issues. Demons responded right away to power and dominance because that was the language their whole culture was based on.
He had just demonstrated complete control over life and death, the ability to protect someone weaker, and such immense power that he turned a divine champion into liquid meat without even trying.
Of course, she was at 70%.
If there were any doubts about his abilities, her desire level would likely be higher.

chapters.title: Chapter 97. I Threatened to Kill Her If It Was a Trap. She Said ’That Sounded Hot.’
paragraphs: Rex then came back to his senses to focus on the demon, and he would use this opportunity to at least bond with a demon. This fantasy world has many things, and it would be a shame for him not to use all of them.
"Thank you..." Lilith said softly and with respect. "Thank you...! Thank you...! Thank yooooouuuu!!!"
"Y-You saved my life... I thought I was going to die, and you came to me like a guardian angel, but not an angel because angels are terrible assholes."

"You came to me like a dark savior who protects the unworthy, and I owe you everything that I have right now!" The demon bowed down. "I owe you my life, my service, and whatever else you want because you saved me when no one else would."
"My loyalty towards the demon king has been replaced by the one and true dark savior..." She tried to lick his boots, but then he dodged it fast.
"Stop it with that." Rex looked disgusted, but the kind of disgust he loves when seeing a woman act lowly toward him.
"You owe me a name for now," Rex said, cutting him off and keeping his voice low and firm. "Spill it."
The mask changed it a little, adding an inhuman tone that made it clear he wasn’t human, even though he looked like a person.
"Lilith!" She said right away, "Lilith Nocturne!"
"I’m Lord Mordecai Vrael’s personal maid, but I guess that doesn’t mean much if I’m dead and alone."

"But now! You saved me, so I’m alive and can still be his personal maid... but still, I owe you everything, so maybe I should be your personal maid instead." Lilith said with her heart-shaped tail moving freely.
"I can be your good maid! How’s that?! Do you want one?!" Lilith keeps getting closer to him. "I’m very good at maid duties! I can clean, organize, gather information, serve tea, and even have sex—"
Rex cut through the nervous chatter and said, "You serve Mordecai, right?"
"Ah~! Yes, I am!" Lilith nodded quickly. "I’ve been his personal assistant for three years."
"I take care of his home, plan his schedule, handle his mail, gather information from his various businesses, and make sure his estate runs smoothly."
"But... he’s odd. Even though he has everything, including all the monster women, he doesn’t want to give them all the pleasure they need... and I needed." Lilith said with a sad look.
"Great to hear that, then..."
It’s better than Rex had hoped. Not only was she connected to Mordecai, but she was also very involved in his personal business.
And the fact that she just said something personal made Rex think that Mordecai was a reincarnator that became a demon lord, and he must be a wimp to not fully take advantage of his privileges.
Rex reached out and took her hand, but she shook her body with her tail raised, feeling very tense.
"Ahh~!" She wrapped her smaller fingers around his right away.
Rex said. "You’re going to take me to him right now. I have some personal business with him.
Lilith nodded. "My pleasure—"
He used his teleportation power again, and Lilith came with him. He had slightly overreached himself with Lustia’s explanation.
He couldn’t handle many people, but one person was fine. The spell structure changed to fit two bodies instead of one, and then they were walking through space together.
They were on a rooftop several blocks away from the eastern wall, far enough away from the main battle that they wouldn’t be seen right away but still close enough to see what was going on.
"I say again... take me to Mordecai," Rex said again. "Right now."
Lilith’s eyes were wide with what looked like a mix of fear, awe, and excitement. "Yes, of course, I can!"
"I have teleportation magic that is much stronger than what you just did and can cross hundreds of miles in an instant, but... Lord Mordecai isn’t alone..."
"He’s with his full inner circle at the staging ground twenty miles north of here, and they were coordinating the attack and waiting for news on how it went."
"Then we go there," Rex said. "Now."
"But you need to understand," Lilith said, her voice getting more serious even though she was clearly in love. "Lord Mordecai has six other personal attendants besides me."
"We all worked together, and if I show up alone with a stranger, especially after the attack failed, they’ll think I’ve been compromised or turned traitor."
"I need to get back together with the others first so we can present you properly, or at least explain the situation before you meet him."
Rex’s foresight saw the branches. If he pushed the issue and went straight to Mordecai now, there would be a fight right away.

There is a chance of winning, but there are also problems that could stop his plan to get in. If he listened to Lilith and met with the other attendants first, he would have to wait, but he would have a much better chance of making himself look like someone Mordecai would want to hire instead of kill.
"Okay then," Rex said. "First, take me to the others."
Rex whispered. "But if this is a trap, you’ll die before your plan can work."
"And I’ll use your body first before I murder you."
Lilith’s body tensed. "T-that sounded hot..."
"Ehem! It’s not a trap, I promise!" Lilith said immediately. "I owe you my life, remember?!"
"I would never betray someone who saved me!" Lilith shook her head. "Demons don’t work that way."
"When we bond, we bond completely! That means... you’re mine now, I mean, I’m yours, I mean, we’re connected, and I would rather die than see you hurt."

Rex noticed that Lilith was already falling for him, which was a good sign because he would soon be able to experience a relationship with a demon after completing his initial plan as the Lustful Villain.
Her eyes were full of real emotion, and Rex could see that she was seventy percent committed to him. It was going exactly as Lustia had said it would.
Demons were loyal to power and control in a way that humans couldn’t be because they didn’t have the same moral issues getting in the way.
"Then let’s not waste any more time and move," Rex said.

Lilith nodded and started to cast a teleportation spell that was much more complicated than Rex’s simple one. With his new energy manipulation sense, he could see the energy patterns forming: layers upon layers of spatial folding and anchoring that would let him travel long distances with great accuracy.
"Hold on to me," she said, and Rex held on tighter.

This time, the world folded in a more planned and controlled way. This was more like being pulled through a tunnel that made distance into a single moment instead of the instant step through space that his own teleportation gave him.
As they emerged, magical lights illuminated a clearing in the woods. There were six other demons around them, all female and wearing different kinds of maid uniforms.
They all turned to look at Lilith and Rex with different looks of surprise.
One of them screamed, "LILITH!" with a tone of relief in her voice.
"We thought you were dead or captured!"
"I almost was," Lilith said as she pulled Rex closer. "But then this charming dark prince saved me."
"This is my savior, my protector, my dark guardian who came out of nowhere and killed the Apostle of Justice, who was hunting me like it was nothing."
"He really killed him without a trace, and it’s amazinngggggg!!!"
The other maids were all staring at Rex now, taking in his masked face and the powerful aura that surrounded him.
"So...? Can I meet with Mordecai and ask some personal things of him?" Rex asked while crossing both his arms.
Somewhere, not too far away.
Rex didn’t know, because he couldn’t see it from where he was standing in the clearing, that a group of four reincarnators had seen the teleportation arrival about half a mile away through the trees.

They had been following Lilith since the fight, hoping to find out where Mordecai was. They were now observing as Lilith brought a masked figure, who was clearly a demon, to a location that unmistakably served as a demonic gathering place.
The leader of the group, a woman with black hair and cold eyes, signaled to her companions.
They would follow at a distance. They would observe.
And if the opportunity presented itself, they would strike.
The hunt was on.

sentences.text: Rex then came back to his senses to focus on the demon, and he would use this opportunity to at least bond with a demon.
This fantasy world has many things, and it would be a shame for him not to use all of them.
"Thank you..." Lilith said softly and with respect.
"Thank you...!
Thank you...!
Thank yooooouuuu!!!"
"Y-You saved my life...
I thought I was going to die, and you came to me like a guardian angel, but not an angel because angels are terrible assholes."
"You came to me like a dark savior who protects the unworthy, and I owe you everything that I have right now!" The demon bowed down.
"I owe you my life, my service, and whatever else you want because you saved me when no one else would."
"My loyalty towards the demon king has been replaced by the one and true dark savior..." She tried to lick his boots, but then he dodged it fast.
"Stop it with that." Rex looked disgusted, but the kind of disgust he loves when seeing a woman act lowly toward him.
"You owe me a name for now," Rex said, cutting him off and keeping his voice low and firm.
"Spill it."
The mask changed it a little, adding an inhuman tone that made it clear he wasn’t human, even though he looked like a person.
"Lilith!" She said right away, "Lilith Nocturne!"
"I’m Lord Mordecai Vrael’s personal maid, but I guess that doesn’t mean much if I’m dead and alone."
"But now!

You saved me, so I’m alive and can still be his personal maid... but still, I owe you everything, so maybe I should be your personal maid instead." Lilith said with her heart-shaped tail moving freely.
"I can be your good maid!
How’s that?!
Do you want one?!" Lilith keeps getting closer to him.
"I’m very good at maid duties!
I can clean, organize, gather information, serve tea, and even have sex—"
Rex cut through the nervous chatter and said, "You serve Mordecai, right?"
"Ah~!
Yes, I am!" Lilith nodded quickly.
"I’ve been his personal assistant for three years."
"I take care of his home, plan his schedule, handle his mail, gather information from his various businesses, and make sure his estate runs smoothly."
"But... he’s odd.
Even though he has everything, including all the monster women, he doesn’t want to give them all the pleasure they need... and I needed." Lilith said with a sad look.
"Great to hear that, then..."
It’s better than Rex had hoped.
Not only was she connected to Mordecai, but she was also very involved in his personal business.
And the fact that she just said something personal made Rex think that Mordecai was a reincarnator that became a demon lord, and he must be a wimp to not fully take advantage of his privileges.
Rex reached out and took her hand, but she shook her body with her tail raised, feeling very tense.
"Ahh~!" She wrapped her smaller fingers around his right away.
Rex said.
"You’re going to take me to him right now.
I have some personal business with him.
Lilith nodded.
"My pleasure—"
He used his teleportation power again, and Lilith came with him.
He had slightly overreached himself with Lustia’s explanation.
He couldn’t handle many people, but one person was fine.
The spell structure changed to fit two bodies instead of one, and then they were walking through space together.
They were on a rooftop several blocks away from the eastern wall, far enough away from the main battle that they wouldn’t be seen right away but still close enough to see what was going on.
"I say again... take me to Mordecai," Rex said again.
"Right now."
Lilith’s eyes were wide with what looked like a mix of fear, awe, and excitement.
"Yes, of course, I can!"
"I have teleportation magic that is much stronger than what you just did and can cross hundreds of miles in an instant, but...
Lord Mordecai isn’t alone..."
"He’s with his full inner circle at the staging ground twenty miles north of here, and they were coordinating the attack and waiting for news on how it went."
"Then we go there," Rex said.
"Now."
"But you need to understand," Lilith said, her voice getting more serious even though she was clearly in love.
"Lord Mordecai has six other personal attendants besides me."
"We all worked together, and if I show up alone with a stranger, especially after the attack failed, they’ll think I’ve been compromised or turned traitor."
"I need to get back together with the others first so we can present you properly, or at least explain the situation before you meet him."
Rex’s foresight saw the branches.
If he pushed the issue and went straight to Mordecai now, there would be a fight right away.
There is a chance of winning, but there are also problems that could stop his plan to get in.

If he listened to Lilith and met with the other attendants first, he would have to wait, but he would have a much better chance of making himself look like someone Mordecai would want to hire instead of kill.
"Okay then," Rex said.
"First, take me to the others."
Rex whispered.
"But if this is a trap, you’ll die before your plan can work."
"And I’ll use your body first before I murder you."
Lilith’s body tensed.
"T-that sounded hot..."
"Ehem!
It’s not a trap, I promise!" Lilith said immediately.
"I owe you my life, remember?!"
"I would never betray someone who saved me!" Lilith shook her head.
"Demons don’t work that way."
"When we bond, we bond completely!
That means... you’re mine now, I mean, I’m yours, I mean, we’re connected, and I would rather die than see you hurt."

Rex noticed that Lilith was already falling for him, which was a good sign because he would soon be able to experience a relationship with a demon after completing his initial plan as the Lustful Villain.
Her eyes were full of real emotion, and Rex could see that she was seventy percent committed to him.
It was going exactly as Lustia had said it would.
Demons were loyal to power and control in a way that humans couldn’t be because they didn’t have the same moral issues getting in the way.
"Then let’s not waste any more time and move," Rex said.
Lilith nodded and started to cast a teleportation spell that was much more complicated than Rex’s simple one.
With his new energy manipulation sense, he could see the energy patterns forming: layers upon layers of spatial folding and anchoring that would let him travel long distances with great accuracy.
"Hold on to me," she said, and Rex held on tighter.
This time, the world folded in a more planned and controlled way.
This was more like being pulled through a tunnel that made distance into a single moment instead of the instant step through space that his own teleportation gave him.
As they emerged, magical lights illuminated a clearing in the woods.
There were six other demons around them, all female and wearing different kinds of maid uniforms.
They all turned to look at Lilith and Rex with different looks of surprise.
One of them screamed, "LILITH!" with a tone of relief in her voice.
"We thought you were dead or captured!"
"I almost was," Lilith said as she pulled Rex closer.
"But then this charming dark prince saved me."
"This is my savior, my protector, my dark guardian who came out of nowhere and killed the Apostle of Justice, who was hunting me like it was nothing."
"He really killed him without a trace, and it’s amazinngggggg!!!"
The other maids were all staring at Rex now, taking in his masked face and the powerful aura that surrounded him.
Can I meet with Mordecai and ask some personal things of him?" Rex asked while crossing both his arms.

They would observe.

chapters.title: Chapter 98. My Foresight Predicted Everything Except That Reaction (She’s a Masochist!)
paragraphs: The six demon maids stood in a loose semicircle around Rex. Their body language told him everything he needed to know about how they felt about the situation at the time.
Even though Lilith gave them a warm welcome, they were suspicious, cautious, and more than a little hostile.

Rex takes a good look at them, one by one, and they look rather unique for his taste. And it makes him think even more that Mordecai was a stupid virgin reincarnator that didn’t take any chances on them.

"Now I’m fucking curious to take a look at this fraud demon lord for making all these demon maids still feel pure in my eyes," Rex thought to himself. "Maybe I should use psychological dominance on him to see if I can harvest a lot of energy."

The first person, well, a demon, to talk was a maid with dark purple hair styled in twin tails and yellow eyes that sparkled with a cunning intelligence. Her uniform was more complicated than the others, with extra frills and what looked like functional armor pieces built into the design.
"I know that Lilith always talks a lot of nonsense, but feeling your weird presence is rather..." She crossed her arms and gave Rex a look that said she didn’t believe him.

"So you want us to believe that you, a stranger in a suspicious mask, just happened to save Lilith out of the goodness of your heart?" Her voice was sharp and accusatory. "Right... before our lord’s attack fails and she conveniently brings you to our meeting place?"
"That’s not suspicious at all."
"Awww~! Come on now, Nyx, he really did save me!" Lilith protested, but Nyx grabbed her shoulder and pulled her back forcefully.
"Your worthless nympho mind has breached your security," Nyx flatly stated. "Everyone knows that succubi can be easily manipulated by mind control or charm magic."
"Judging by his presence... he probably used one of those on you."
Another maid, this one with red eyes and silver hair like Lilith’s, nodded in agreement. "She’s theoretically correct!"
"This whole thing smells like a trap... For all we know, he’s an apostle of life in disguise trying to get into Lord Mordecai’s inner circle."
Rex didn’t answer when the maid just said ’apostle of life.’ For now he just wants to see where this conversation will lead him, while also studying them all.
A third maid, who was smaller than the others and had cat-like ears and a tail, hissed softly. "It’s the safest option to kill him now and ask questions later."
Rex watched the proceedings happen with a detached sense of humor. The maids were doing exactly what excellent employees should do when they think there might be a security breach.
They were protecting their lord and their organization by defaulting to suspicion instead of trust.
Unfortunately for the maids, their lord did not have time for lengthy explanations or trust-building activities.
"Are you all fucking stupid bitches that shared one brain cell or what?" Rex said, "One of your allies, Lilith, told you I saved her life."

The mask changed his voice so that it sounded like something not human. "You don’t believe her when she says I killed an apostle of justice without any trouble because you think she’s been compromised or tricked."
"It’s really the truth, isn’t it? All demon bitches only share one brain cell." Rex said with a mocking tone.
They looked pissed when he said that and almost attacked him, but he had already made a force field with his telekinesis so that no one could get close to him.
He stopped for a moment, letting the silence last. "Okay, I’ll prove it..."
"Who wants to see if I can do what she said I could do?"
"I’ll just fight any of you to prove it." Rex raised his right hand to taunt them one by one. "I can just beat you without trying."
Nyx, the maid with the purple hair, stepped forward right away. "Okay then, hot shot. It seems like you really went overboard with your worthless words.
"I’ll check your claims myself. If you’re as strong as Lilith says, then you probably won’t mind a simple test."
"Come at me then. Make sure to fight with your killing instinct as a demon."
"Ohh... you really did it this time!"
She moved like a predator, pulling out a pair of nasty-looking daggers from her uniform. "Show me this incredible power that is said to have turned an apostle into liquid meat."
Rex’s Foresight made it very clear what would happen in the next sixty seconds. Nyx would attack with the real goal of killing him, testing both his reflexes and his willingness to fight back.
The other maids would watch closely and judge how he reacted. If he showed any weakness or doubt, they would all attack him at once.
"Fucking great... This is another perfect chance for me to prove my worth to those demons."
"Enough talk," Rex said simply. "Just come at me right now before I get bored."

Nyx lunged, and even by demon standards, she was very fast. Her daggers came at her opponent from two different angles at the same time, a practiced move that made them choose which attack to block while leaving themselves open to the other.

Rex’s telekinesis stopped both blades in mid-strike, holding them so tightly that they felt like they were stuck in concrete. Nyx’s eyes got bigger as she tried to pull back, but the daggers wouldn’t move.
"W-What...?!" Nyx looked shocked. "T-That’s impossible...! What level of telekinesis is this!?"
"Full fucking potential, bitch."
After that, Rex showed off his power.

He moved the telekinetic grip from the daggers to Nyx herself and lifted her off the ground like someone would pick up a piece of paper. Her feet left the ground, and invisible hands held her body three feet in the air.
"Urgghhhh~!" She made a startled sound. "Fuck...! I underestimate him...!"
"Let me show you and all your bitches a good demonstration of trusting a masked man like me," Rex said.
Then he pushed her down to the ground with full force.
The force of the impact caused a crater in the ground and left her breathless with an explosive gasp. Rex picked her up again and threw her sideways into a tree trunk before she could get better.
The wood broke when it hit Nyx, and her body crumpled against it before sliding down to the ground.
"Stop!" one of the other maids yelled, but Rex didn’t listen.
He picked Nyx up again and spun her through the air like a ragdoll before throwing her back down to the ground from a different angle. Then it hit another tree.
Then they fell face-first into the dirt.
Then it hit a boulder in the back, which broke under the force of the impact.
His Foresight told him exactly how each crash would happen. Hard enough to hurt, hard enough to show complete control, but not hard enough to hurt for good.
He was trying to make a point, not hurt her other than by making a fool of herself.
"Isn’t this embarrassing? You, out of all demons, felt like a puppet!" Rex laughed. "Is this the quality of all the demons that Mordecai leads?!"

Rex finally picked Nyx up again after the seventh or eighth hit and held her there, about six feet off the ground. Then his telekinesis wrapped around her neck, and an invisible hand held it just tight enough to make it hard for her to breathe.
"Let’s see if you can last through this one..."

Nyx’s hands instinctively went up to claw at the force that was choking her, but there was nothing to grab. Her legs kicked around in the air for no reason, and the pressure and lack of oxygen made her face turn red.
The other maids stood still, horrified and fascinated at the same time. Lilith looked torn between being worried about her friend and being pleased that Rex was proving her right.
And then something happened that was not planned at all.
Nyx’s face changed. The fear and panic went away and were replaced by something else.
Her struggles got less desperate and more trying. Her eyes, which had been wide with fear, now had a very different kind of intensity until a heart symbol appeared.
And she cried out. "Hyaahhhnnnn~!"
It wasn’t a sound of pain or worry. It was a moan of pure pleasure that didn’t belong in any other context.
"What the fuck...?" Rex was caught off guard seeing her moan out of nowhere.
[NYX SHADOWMERE DETECTED]
[CLASSIFICATION: DEMON - MASOCHIST VARIANT]
[DESIRE LEVEL: 0/100 → 45/100]
[REASON: PHYSICAL DOMINATION, DISPLAY OF OVERWHELMING POWER, PAIN CONVERTED TO PLEASURE THROUGH MASOCHISTIC NATURE]
’Masochist... that explains why.’
Rex’s grip on her throat got a little looser, enough for her to breathe but not enough for him to let her go. Nyx’s moan got louder.
"Ahhhhnnn~! Harder~!"
Her face was red now, but she was getting enough oxygen. Her body had gone from fighting to nearly melting in his telekinetic grip.
"Oh demonnns," she gasped, her voice breathless and full of desire. "Yes~! More~! Choke me harder~! Please don’t stop, masked man~!"
The other maids were staring now, and their faces showed a range of emotions, from shock to understanding to barely hidden amusement.
"Of course Nyx would like this," one of them said under their breath.
"She’s been looking for someone who could really control her for years."

chapters.title: Chapter 99. They Arrived With a Fireball. It Came Back Twice as Big. Poor Planning.
paragraphs: "So you like that one, huh, bitch?!" Rex smirks. "Here, let me give you a good hard squeeze while you enjoy being humiliated by someone you didn’t trust!"

Rex made the choice to give her what she wanted. His telekinesis tightened around her throat again, cutting off her air completely this time, and he slammed her into the ground one more time with enough force to make a small crater.
"Ahhhnnn~! Yes~ Moreeee~! Moreeeeee~!!! I love it!" Nyx keeps screaming and moaning. "I want you to keep hurting me like this until I trust you fully with my heart’s desire~!"
"Heh! What a weird fucking nympho bitch."
After that, he picked her up, spun her around, and threw her through two trees, one after the other. Finally, he caught her and held her in the air again.

"Ohhhhhhh~! Again~! Again~! And again~! Until I can’t feel a thing...!" Nyx starts breathing hard with her mouth drooling. "You can stab me as well, you know?! Use that sharp trunk to stab me in the stomaaaaccchhhhh~!"

Nyx was shaking all over, and it was clear that she was getting more and more ecstatic instead of in pain. Her eyes were half-closed, her breathing was fast and shallow, and when Rex’s invisible grip tightened around her throat one last time, she went completely still before making an unmistakable sound.
She had just reached her peak after being hit and choked with telekinesis.
"Hah... hah... hah..." Nyx showed a fucked-up face where it felt like she had just experienced hard sex. "I can’t keep up with his roughness... noooooo..."
Rex let her go, and she fell to the ground in a boneless heap, twitching a little and making small joyful sounds.
"It... was... worth it... ahhnn~!"
For about three seconds, the clearing was completely quiet.
Then Lilith ran forward with a look of pure victory on her face. "You all see that? SEE?!"
"I told you he was strong, especially with that telekinesis of his!" Lilith starts jumping excitedly. "So it is the truth that he saved me from one of the apostles!"
"Did you think I was lying? Well, it turns out I wasn’t!"
"He’s just as amazing as I said, and you all doubted me, but now you can see it for yourself and feel ashamed of yourselves!"
She was almost vibrating with vindicated energy when she grabbed Rex’s arm in a possessive way. "Thank you for doubting me, you all owe me an apology now!"
"Especially to my savior, my protector, my dark guardian who turns apostles into puddles and demon maids into quivering messes!"
The maid with purple hair who had first challenged Rex was quiet, but her face had changed from suspicion to something more like respect.
The maid with cat ears was nervously swishing her tail.
The maid with silver hair was helping Nyx sit up, but Nyx still looked completely out of it and happy.
"Well... uh... point made," the maid with silver hair said at last. "Sorry for doubting you, masked man."
Rex nodded. "It’s alright. I have my fun anyway with that masochist bitch.
"My name is Sera, and these are Mika, Clara, Yuna, and Nyx. Anyone who can do that to Nyx without killing her is the real deal because she acts like a tank in battles for us all."
She pointed to each of the other maids in turn. "We’re Lord Mordecai’s personal servants, his inner circle of people who gather information and run his household."
"If you want to meet him, we can set it up, but first... with all due respect, we need to know what you really want."
Rex was about to say something when his Foresight suddenly flared up, warning him of an attack coming from behind.
"Just one second," Rex smirked. "There’s some trash that could bring me to your lord even closer."

He moved without thinking, raising one hand and pointing a single finger at the source of the threat. A huge fireball, at least the size of a carriage, was flying through the air toward the clearing, right at the group of demon maids.

There were three other people behind her. A man with short black hair and armor that looked like it belonged to a samurai, holding a katana that looked like it had been used a lot.
A woman with pink hair styled in fancy curls and wearing robes that showed she was a mage or healer.
Additionally, there was another woman with short white hair who was carrying an unstrung bow.

[TAKEDA SHIN - WARRIOR, SYSTEM: BUSHIDO CODE]
[KAGURA HOSHINO - HEALER, SYSTEM: DIVINE MERCY]
[AYAME YUKIMURA - ARCHER, SYSTEM: PERFECT AIM]

"Demons!" Rei shouted in a way that sounded like she was trying to convince herself as much as her audience. "We will stop your evil and bring you to justice for your crimes against humanity in the name of balance and justice!"
Sera and the others start to get ready. "Give us a fucking break! We ran off this far away, and all of you are still desperate enough to chase us all?!"
"Enough talk! I will not let you all run away this time!"

She raised her staff, and the other three members of her group spread out in a basic tactical formation. They had clearly practiced this, but their sloppy performance made it clear that they hadn’t fought together very much.
"Three of you," Rei said, pointing at Takeda, Kagura, and Ayame. "Concentrate on the demon maids."
"I’ll take care of the one with the mask. He’s obviously their leader or some kind of demon commander."
Rex felt a laugh building up in his chest. "This was going to be fun for the both of us!"
"Stay back," he told the maids, and his voice was full of power. "I’ll take care of this trash!!"
"Think of it as another test of my skills to prove my trust to the demons."
Then he walked up to Rei, moving slowly and casually.

Rei hit first, and her staff sent three bolts of concentrated magical energy screaming at Rex from different directions. They were made to home in on their target and change their paths mid-flight to make them harder to avoid.
Rex didn’t even try to get out of the way. His telekinesis reached out and grabbed all three bolts at once, keeping them frozen in the air about two feet from his mask.
Then he casually changed their course, sending them back toward Rei in a spiral with more speed.
"I-Impossible!"
She barely had time to put up a defensive barrier, and even then the force of the attack that came back pushed her back a few steps.
Rex said, "Impressive," but his tone made it clear that he didn’t think so.
"You can stop your own attacks... how clever!"

chapters.title: Chapter 100. Balance Breaker vs. A Guy Who Simply Did Not Move. (One of Us Won)
paragraphs: Rei’s eyes narrowed, and she started to cast a spell that was more complicated. It took longer for this one to form because energy was building up at the tip of her staff in a swirling vortex of different elements.
"I really need to let it all out to beat all of you at once," Rei shouted. "I got nothing to lose starting from this point on...!!!"

All of the magic of fire, ice, lightning, and force is combined into one powerful attack, and Rex could see that it was a powerful merge of magic from her own energy manipulation. But still, it’s not enough to stop Rex’s powerful telekinesis.
"I will not move from this spot, so let it all out—"
"ELEMENTAL MERGEFUL FORCEEEE!!!" She let it go with a shout, and the spell shot forward like a tiny comet, leaving behind burned air and a trail of colorful energy.
Rex’s Foresight had shown him exactly how this would go down. He waited until the spell was about six feet away, then he used his energy manipulation to break it up.
The carefully woven structure of the spell disintegrated like a thread unraveling from a sweater, transforming the once devastating attack into harmless wisps of magic that gradually faded away.
"What a pathetic puny attack... is that all you got after saying you got nothing to lose?" Rex asked, "I thought an apostle of balance would do more."

Rex saw that the rest of her friends were targeting the demon maids, and he needed to help them build their trust even further. He wasn’t going to let Rei’s three friends move forward on the demon maids as ordered.

His telekinesis reached out in three different directions at once, wrapping around Takeda, Kagura, and Ayame and slamming them face-first into the ground with full force on their backs and the tops of their heads.
Then he pushed down harder and harder until he felt pressure. Not enough to kill them right away, but enough to stop them from moving.
"Urrggghhhh...! I can’t... move!" Kagura tried to resist.
"My body... it feels all tired and weak!" Takeda gritted his teeth.
Ayame said. "This is probably one of his powers...!"
They fought to resist the force from the telekinesis, their arms and legs flailing around uselessly, but it was like they were trying to lift a mountain off their backs.
"Your friends are busy there with the burden on their backs." Rex turned his attention back to Rei and said, "Now you have my full attention... and I hope you can make this more interesting."
Rei was losing her composure. He could tell she was thinking about retreating by the way her hands shook a little on her staff, the way her eyes widened, and the way her weight shifted slightly.
"Ohh...? "What’s this?" Rex noticed and then taunted him instead. "Have you lost all of your bravado from earlier?"
"Was it worth it to charge at someone that’s stronger than you, lowly scum?"
"There’s no way in hell I would run away like you cowards!" Rei starts to get frustrated hearing his taunt.
She didn’t run, which is a good thing. Instead, she planted her feet and started sending out power on a level that Rex had never seen before.
The air around her was full of energy, and the ground beneath her feet started to glow with complicated magical circles.
"BALANCE BREAKER!" she shouted, letting go of everything she had.
The spell was really cool, even for Rex. It used both offensive and defensive magic in a way that should have been deadly.
It made a wave of destructive force that tried to destroy everything in its path while also keeping the caster safe from attack.
Rex’s Foresight showed him 17 different ways to fight it. He picked the one that was the least polite.
He walked straight into the wave of energy, moving slowly and steadily. The spell struck him with the force of a tidal wave, engulfing him in a moment of intense, bright light.
"Masked man!" Lilith was shocked seeing Rex make that unpredictable move.
After that, the light went out, and Rex was still standing where he had been before, unharmed. And there’s not even a scratch on his mask, and that surprised everyone there.
Rei’s expression looked shocked and scared at the same time. "No way... that was my most... powerful move!"
"Powerful...? More like garbage," he said. "Now it’s my turn!"

His telekinesis reached out and grabbed Rei by the waist, lifting her off the ground. She tried to fight back, cast spells to protect herself, and do anything else she could think of to get free, but it was like trying to fight against gravity itself.
Rex started to have fun with her.
At first, he spun her slowly through the air, but then he sped up and up until she was a blur of motion. Then he suddenly stopped her, and the whiplash made her gasp.
He lifted her higher, then let her fall almost to the ground before catching her at the last second. He squeezed a little, not enough to break ribs but enough to make it hard to breathe.
His foresight showed him her growing fear, her realization that she was completely outmatched, and her dawning understanding that she was going to die here.
"Please," she finally managed to beg, "please stop it...!"
"I... I give up! I’ll do anything... just let me go!"
Rex thought about it for exactly one second. Then he looked over at Takeda, Kagura, and Ayame, who were still pinned to the ground and couldn’t move. T
Their faces were turned toward their leader, and they looked scared and hopeless.
Kagura said. "Please stop...! We gave up!"
"Gave up? Come on now, we just started!" Rex felt disappointed.
"Well, no one cares anyway."
"Pay close attention," Rex told them. "This is what happens to people who go against me."
Then he made a fist.

The telekinetic force around Rei pushed in from all sides at the same time. There was a sound like many things breaking at once, a wet crunching that echoed through the clearing, and Rei’s scream stopped suddenly.
CRACKKKKK!
When Rex opened his fist and let go of the telekinetic grip, what fell to the ground looked like it had been human at one point, but now it isn’t.
"There you go. Fast and easy, to the afterlife she goes to meet her god," Rex said while clapping.
Her body had been crushed so badly that her bones had turned to dust, her organs had burst and merged, and the only thing holding it all together was the remains of her armor and clothes.
Kagura was screaming. Takeda made sounds like he was trying not to throw up. Ayame had turned completely white and was silent, shock taking over all other reactions.
Rex looked at them, but his face was blank behind the mask. "You have two choices."
"Fight me and join her, or give up and live."
"Choose now," Rex raised his fist.
Kagura’s scream stopped right away. Takeda’s hands, which had been reaching for his fallen sword, stopped moving. Ayame just stared at him with eyes that were empty from fear.
"Y-YES...! W-We give up," Takeda was able to say while peeing his pants. "P-P-Please...! We give up for good! Spare us all...!"
Rex let go of the pressure that was holding them down, but he kept his telekinesis ready in case they did something dumb.
And of course, they didn’t.
They just lay there on the ground, shaking and broken.
He looked back at the demon maids, who had all had different reactions to the show. It was clear that Nyx was turned on again, because that’s how she is.
Sera looked impressed and a little scared. Some were interested and some were disturbed, while Lilith was thrilled.
Rex asked, "Is this enough proof?"
A sound cut through the clearing before anyone could answer. A deep, resonant horn sound came from the direction of Aethelgard.
The signal that demon armies used to tell each other to back off when a battle was going badly.
"That sound... the attack has failed," Sera said in a matter-of-fact tone. "Lord Mordecai will be calling all troops back to the staging grounds and then back to headquarters."
"Right on time," Rex said.
He pointed to the three reincarnators who were still alive. "Bind those three."
"They’re proof of my worth to your lord." Rex crossed his arms. "Three captured apostles and reincarnators, delivered directly to him."
"That should prove my worth to face him."
The maids swiftly drew ropes and bound spells from their supplies with a familiar ease. Takeda, Kagura, and Ayame were all tied up and gagged in less than a minute, and their weapons were taken away.
"You’re smarter than you look," Nyx said, getting up even though she was still a little shaky. "Taking prisoners shows that you are thinking strategically instead of just killing everyone you meet."
"Lord Mordecai likes that kind of thinking."
"Then let’s not waste any more time," Rex said.
"Bring me to him."
